name: Antananarivo
tagline: Hilltop capital and launchpad for lemurs and baobabs
summary: Antananarivo, or Tana, is Madagascar's capital, a jumble of red-brick houses on twelve hills. See the Rova royal palace above the city, visit the sacred hill of Ambohimanga, meet lemurs at Lemurs' Park, and set out for the rainforest of Andasibe or the famous Avenue of the Baobabs.
seasonNote: April to November is dry; December to March is cyclone and rainy season.
arrival: Ivato International is 30 to 60 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Taxis by agreement or a car with driver; traffic is heavy.
cashTip: Madagascar uses the ariary (about 5,000 to 1 euro); prices here are in euros. Cash is king outside hotels; ATMs work in Tana but are scarce elsewhere.
foodTip: Romazava, zebu brochettes, mofo gasy and vanilla everything.
buyTip: Vanilla, raffia crafts and embroidery at the Digue market.
